premises.text: Widespread poor sleep imposes large cognitive, physical, and economic costs
premises.evidence_span: Nearly half of the Western population reports bad quality of sleep or even lack of it, costing billions of dollars to their employers and to the society

premises.text: Wearables with general tips and coaching are not enough to solve sleep deprivation
premises.evidence_span: providing you wearable devices and trackers and some general tips and coaching on how to change your habits towards better sleep. But that is not enough

premises.text: Personalized mobile sleep coaching connects to favorite wearables and is developed with leading sleep researchers
premises.evidence_span: Nuxo Sleep Coaching, personalized sleep coaching in a mobile phone. You can use it with your favorite wearable device

premises.text: App assesses a sleep coaching profile from tracker data and delivers weekly lesson-based habit coaching that improves as it learns
premises.evidence_span: Based on the data, we assess your sleep coaching profile. And after that, you can continue to coaching directly

premises.text: Coaching focuses on circadian/homeostatic rhythms and fixing melatonin onset around the natural circadian rhythm
premises.evidence_span: We are focusing on mostly fixing your melatonin onset in the nighttime and working around your natural circadian rhythm

premises.text: First targeting European employers and consumers via occupational health and life-insurance partners plus App Store coaching purchases
